Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in its analysis of the WebSurfer's findings regarding the film "Education Of A Prince". The WebSurfer correctly identified two films with this title: a 1927 French silent film and a 1938 French comedy film. The Planner incorrectly concluded that the 1938 film was an "American film (United States)" based on a hallucinated detail about "U.S. distribution via United Artists" which was not present in the WebSurfer's provided text. Consequently, the Planner incorrectly determined that both films were from the same country (United States), leading to the wrong final answer of "Yes" instead of the correct "No" (since both films are actually French).
